pages.text: It came at me the moment it saw me, and I did what anyone would do. Now it lies still, and I cannot stop looking at it. It looks like the creatures from home, but wrong, as if someone drew it from memory and forgot the important parts. Cyan light leaks from cracks in its body like water from a broken jar. And the way it looked at me, just before it attacked. Not like an animal looks at prey. Like it recognised me. Like I was someone it used to know, or someone it was waiting for. I tell myself that is the strangeness of this place playing tricks on me. I tell myself many things lately.
